harness: verdict.py, PROVABLE stance, term/tactic bodies, Mathlib-only

items.name: B1_drop_all_distinctness_false
items.proposition: ∀ A : Finset (Fin 3 → ZMod 3), A.Nonempty → ¬ (∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A, ∀ z ∈ A, x + y + z ≠ 0)

items.name: B2_guards_flipped_to_eq_false
items.proposition: ∀ A : Finset (Fin 3 → ZMod 3), A.Nonempty → ¬ (∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A, ∀ z ∈ A, x = y → y = z → x = z → x + y + z ≠ 0)

items.name: B3_drop_one_inequality_equivalent
items.proposition: ∀ A : Finset (Fin 3 → ZMod 3), (∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A, ∀ z ∈ A, x ≠ y → y ≠ z → x + y + z ≠ 0) ↔ (∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A, ∀ z ∈ A, x ≠ y → y ≠ z → x ≠ z → x + y + z ≠ 0)

items.name: B4_sum_form_iff_ap_form
items.proposition: ∀ x y z : Fin 3 → ZMod 3, x + y + z = 0 ↔ x + z = (2 : ℕ) • y
